overview_description.description:
Finnix is a financial technology solutions provider for the creative industry.



Finnix provides financial management tools for event organizers, agencies, and concert promoters.




Finnix was founded in 2021 and was headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.

about_short_description.short_description: Finnix is a financial technology solutions provider for the creative industry.

product.name: Financial Reporting and Document Preparation
product.description: Preparation and organization of professional financial documents, including support for budgeting, project tracking, and cash-flow management.

product.name: Project-Based Financing
product.description: Financing support for creative-industry projects through fixed-term loans arranged with Cicil and participating rural banks (BPRs).

product.name: Payment Handling
product.description: Payment tools and transaction support for managing project payments, including payments made directly to verified vendors.

product.name: Event Consultation
product.description: Consultation for planning, coordinating, and executing events across financial and operational requirements.

product.name: Event Technology
product.description: Technology solutions for planning, managing, and delivering events, with tools intended to improve event operations and audience experiences.

product.name: Vendor Partner Network
product.description: Connections to vendors that provide services and expertise required for event production and delivery.
